comment: The single list of public mods: every build, packaging, verification and publishing script reads it, and mod submissions add to it. 'folder' is the project under mods/cs, 'modId' the mod's Id in game, 'id' its catalog package. 'legacy' mods keep the historical JibbersMods/<id>.dll path that installed bootstraps migrate from native plugins; the others install as JibbersMods/cs/<id>.dll. 'version' pins a package version instead of the channel build number. 'authors' are the GitHub accounts that may submit updates to a mod (maintainers always can).

mods.name: Alpine Vision
mods.description: Atmosphere extended: weather, alpine sky, lighting and a URP cinematic finish. Retains game shadows. Replaces Atmosphere.

mods.name: Rewind
mods.description: C# physics history, hold to rewind and resume.

mods.name: FPV Drone
mods.description: C# drone flight, camera, controls, HUD and audio.

mods.name: Slow Motion
mods.description: Click the left stick or press V to slow the game down, with smooth easing.

mods.name: Rumble
mods.description: Controller vibration that follows the game's own sounds: landings, rails, crashes and hard carves. Xbox and PlayStation pads.

mods.name: SLVSH
mods.description: S.K.A.T.E. on snow with your Steam party: set tricks, match them, watch each turn and vote on close calls.

mods.name: Join Spawn
mods.description: Spawn next to a player in your session instead of at a spawn point: pick them from a list (F6), set the offset, and keep their speed and direction.

mods.name: Chair Lift
mods.description: Ride the chair lifts: sit with friends, use the phone on the way up, get off at the top.
